payload.summary: Incident INC-000001: a PPE violation was detected on camera CAM_001 in the WELDING zone at 10:30:06 UTC on 2026-10-31. The detection shows a missing helmet. It is a single event and is not flagged for review. Severity is HIGH (score 72), based on the PPE violation base score (30), the missing helmet (+25), and the WELDING zone multiplier (x1.3).
recommended_actions: Ask the worker to stop work and put on approved head protection before continuing, per SOP-PPE-01 (Head protection).
Record the incident in the incident log with the date, zone (WELDING) and the corrective action taken, per SOP-PPE-01 (Documentation).
Record the violation only once it is confirmed, since the SOP requires logging of confirmed PPE violations.
If missing helmet violations repeat, escalate to the area supervisor, per SOP-PPE-01 (Head protection). This is currently a single event.

payload.summary: Incident INC-000002 is a restricted area entry detected by CAM_001 in the PRESS_RESTRICTED zone at 2026-10-31T10:30:10.000Z. Log the event as a restricted area entry incident (INC-000002) if it has not already been logged.
Confirm whether the person involved was authorised for the PRESS_RESTRICTED zone, using the CAM_001 footage from around 10:30:10 UTC on 2026-10-31.
Keep the severity at HIGH as assigned.
